text:
jeremy-support: Heads-up — AcmeML customer on our shared-VPC private installer is blocking on egress. Installer fails while pulling runtime deps and model shards. Repro attached below.

linda-customer: Repro steps I ran locally inside their bastion: 
1) run installer script
2) hits pip installs and model download
3) fails with SSL verify error

linda-customer: curl output from bastion: 
```
$ curl -v https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/.../somewheel.whl -o /tmp/somewheel.whl
* Rebuilt URL to: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/.../somewheel.whl
*   Trying 151.101.0.223...
* Connected to files.pythonhosted.org (151.101.0.223) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert protocol version
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert protocol version
```

jeremy-support: Also seeing python error when pip tries to verify certs: 
```
requests.exceptions.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1108)
```

emma-infra: pinging @sam-security and @deploy-bot — likely egress/transparent-proxy or MITM TLS intercept. Linda, can you share traceroute and openssl s_client with SNI?

linda-customer: here you go (redacted IPs):
```
$ openssl s_client -connect files.pythonhosted.org:443 -servername files.pythonhosted.org -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=2 C = US, O = ExampleCA, CN = Example Root CA
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
No client certificate CA names sent
---
SSL handshake has read 1023 bytes and written 315 bytes
---
```

emma-infra: Ok. Customer's network appears to be doing TLS inspection or missing public CA roots. To get installer to succeed we need an allowlist for outbound hosts + advice for TLS passthrough. Proposed allowlist (minimal):
- files.pythonhosted.org, pypi.org (443)
- debian.org, deb.debian.org, security.debian.org (443)
- storage.googleapis.com (443) for some model shards
- cdn.jsdelivr.net (443)
- ghcr.io (443) for some container pulls
- registry.redwood-inference.com (443) (customer-specific registry)
- model-registry-us-west.s3.amazonaws.com (443) (model shard host pattern)
- telemetry.api.redwood-inference.com (443) (telemetry/usage ping)
- auth.redwood-inference.com (443) (token exchange / OIDC)
- kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com (443) (optional for KMS-backed keywrap)

sam-security: Additions/notes: include OCSP/CRL hosts for public CAs and allow outbound UDP/443 to CDNs. Recommend customers avoid TLS MITM for installer and instead do: whitelist by hostname + port and enable TLS passthrough on their proxy. Also note we never send secrets in plaintext; token exchange uses TLS to auth.redwood-inference.com — please ensure they allow outbound CONNECT to that host.

emma-infra: Also need IP ranges if security team wants firewall rules: for pypi/files.pythonhosted.org use Cloudflare ranges (~151.101.0.0/16 etc) and Google Storage ranges for storage.googleapis.com. I'll attach links to current ranges.

linda-customer: Customer asked if we can provide a single JSON they can drop into their allowlist automation. They also asked for a minimal fallback if ops cannot allow external egress (enterprise customers only): offline bundle + local artifactory mirror instructions.

jeremy-support: Action items:
- @emma-infra: produce allowlist JSON + IP ranges + port list (443) and note about SNI passthrough + OCSP endpoints.
- @sam-security: provide wording for compliance (do not disable TLS verification; recommend installing CA chain only if they control proxy).
- @deploy-bot: create support ticket and link KB.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INC-34721 and KB doc draft: https://redwood-internal.kb/INC-34721 (private). Assigned to emma-infra.

emma-infra: ETA for JSON and KB draft ~ 2 business hours, will include: allowlist JSON, curl repro, openssl guidance, and offline bundle link.

linda-customer: Thanks — customer will try whitelist first and report back. :thumbsup:

sam-security: one more note — if they must intercept TLS, they need to import the proxy CA into the OS trust store for the installer user, otherwise pip/wget/openssl will fail. Explicitly call this out in KB.

jeremy-support: Cool. I'll follow up after emma posts the KB. Closing thread when ticket is updated. :white_check_mark:
